name: Your First Feline Friend

angles.text: Night elves have long raised these fierce cats as trusted steeds under the moon's grace.

faq.answer: They are remarkably intelligent beasts and fiercely loyal to whoever bonds with them.
Look over the available cats and decide which one you wish to journey with across the world.
faq.q: How do you choose your saber?

faq.answer: Any saber you feel drawn toward will prove a faithful and steadfast partner on your travels.
faq.q: Can you make the wrong choice?

faq.answer: The trainer invokes Elune to watch over you and your new companion as you ride into the wider world.

sections.body: A riding saber is no ordinary beast of burden. These great cats possess sharp wits and remain steadfastly devoted to the rider who earns their trust. You stand before them now to examine each one and discover which companion will journey beside you across the wilderness.
sections.title: A Loyal Companion

sections.body: Once your decision is made, the bond between rider and beast takes root immediately. The chosen cat takes to you warmly, ready to venture forth under the watchful blessing of Elune.
sections.title: The Bound Steed

summary: You stand ready to choose your first riding saber and venture out into the wider world. These intelligent cats form deep, steadfast bonds with those who ride them.
